title: rubus nitidus subsp. plicatus
intro: Rubus nitidus subsp. plicatus, commonly known as the Himalayan raspberry, is a subspecies of the Rubus nitidus plant, belonging to the family Rosaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help in treating wounds, reducing fever, and alleviating digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Rubus nitidus subsp. plicatus include antioxidant, anti-diarrheal, and anti-cancer properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. The bioactive constituents of this plant may also exhibit vasodilatory and anti-proliferative effects, contributing to its potential health benefits.
